description_en: Queries online editing projects by creation time and status
description_zh: 支持按创建时间、状态搜索
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-editing-project --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --status Producing --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --create-source WebSDK --template-type Timeline --project-type EditingProject --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchEditingProject

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en:
The status of the online editing project. Separate multiple values with commas (,). By default, all online editing projects are queried.

Valid values:

-Draft

-Producing

-Produced

-ProduceFailed
parameters.description_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。默认获取所有云剪辑工程。

取值范围：

\-Draft：草稿。

\-Producing：合成中。

\-Produced：合成成功。

\-ProduceFailed：合成失败。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.description_en:
The sorting rule of results. Valid values:

\- CreationTime:Desc (default): The results are sorted in reverse chronological order based on the creation time.

\- CreationTime:Asc: The results are sorted in chronological order based on the creation time.
parameters.description_zh:
结果排序方式。取值范围：

\-CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。

\-CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序。

parameters.description_en:
The source of the project.

-OpenAPI

-AliyunConsole

-WebSDK

Valid values:

- AliyunConsole: The project is created in the Alibaba Cloud console.

- WebSDK: The project is created by using the SDK for Web.

- OpenAPI: The project is created by calling API operations.
